change: Enable the measured two-tile eager 10 MiB allreduce schedule for the qualified Windows dual-5070-Ti profile; preserve whole-buffer and captured fallback paths.
hardware: 2 x RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB / 70 SM, native Windows WDDM, no CUDA P2P; CUDA runtime/driver 13.4.
artifact: Pinned Qwen3.8-27B mixed NVFP4 NInfer v2 (registered qwen3_8_27b / nvfp4).

operator.schedule: Automatic (WholeBuffer retained as the public reference)
operator.gate: Windows WDDM; both devices sm_120, 70 SM; CUDA peer access denied both ways; sufficient provisioned pinned capacity; exact 10 MiB; neither main stream capturing.
operator.owned_resources: Reuse the per-rank portable pinned buffers; add one nonblocking D2H stream and two tile-ready events per rank. No new device scratch or Op-time allocation.
operator.ordering: Both current tile publications precede peer waits; main streams join their outgoing copy and the peer's inbound copy before combining or reusing storage. Owner teardown retires all four streams.
operator.arithmetic: The existing full-buffer residual_add is unchanged: BF16 inputs, FP32 sum, one BF16 store rounding.
operator.fallback: Other sizes/gathers retain existing transport; captured 10 MiB calls retain the previous fallback.

operator_validation.eager: Three epochs per policy/order: 10 MiB sum -> 131078-byte sum -> 10 MiB sum -> unequal 65542/98314-byte gather -> 10 MiB sum, all on one pinned-buffer owner without intervening host synchronization.
operator_validation.oracle: Full independent FP64 sums of bounded represented inputs and byte-exact gathers (including NaN payloads/signed zero); full-index/rank/call/epoch changing input.
operator_validation.reuse: Every output/publication retained, including partial-transfer tails; device/pinned guards and alternating delayed producers.
operator_validation.capture_and_lifetime: Two changed graph replays/order, untouched pinned buffers during capture, subsequent eager reuse; in-flight move, swap assignment and destructor retirement. Fixture owner retires before device storage is freed.
operator_validation.route_admission: Automatic asserted active, WholeBuffer asserted inactive; actual pinned publications checked.

operator_performance.comparison: Public allreduce_sum, Automatic versus explicit WholeBuffer.
operator_performance.method: 8 warmup collectives/route; 31 alternating paired samples/order, 32 zero-input in-place sums/sample. Full nonzero qualification before/after timing and resident checks after every sample.
operator_performance.timing_scope: Joined CUDA event interval includes both ranks' completed sums. Host enqueue and complete-wall intervals are reported separately. Source setup and correctness checks are outside timing.
operator_performance.tradeoff: Joined completion improves about 3%; host enqueue cost rises about 65-70% by median paired ratio. Whole-engine measurements below decide adoption.

focused_regression.prefix: Eager and graphs: four matched-schedule restore/replay controls have exact first logits, 16/16 continuation tokens and MTP counts; peer egress agrees in 75 rounds/mode.
focused_regression.existing_different_schedule_diagnostic: 11/16 initial tokens agree; first-logit max_abs 0.40625, RMS 0.0756257. This diagnostic is not the matched-schedule exactness contract.

model_performance.comparison: Fresh preserved pre-change engine versus Automatic candidate, sequential run blocks.
model_performance.interpretation: Prefill throughput increases 2.17% at 8K and 1.53% at 100K. Decode throughput is effectively unchanged in these runs.

device_workspace.scope: These are the reported device-workspace fields for both workloads, not total process or CUDA Graph memory.
